SELECT json_build_object(
  'stale_findings', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.days_stale DESC) FROM (
    SELECT pf.id::text AS finding_id, pf.pathology_type AS type, pf.severity, pf.description,
      pf.affects_safety, pf.estimated_intervention_cost_min AS cost_min, pf.estimated_intervention_cost_max AS cost_max, pf.recommended_action,
      pf.status, pf.updated_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - pf.updated_at))/86400)::int AS days_stale,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, p.current_phase
    FROM pathology_findings pf
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = pf.project_id
    WHERE pf.status NOT IN ('repaired', 'dismissed', 'monitored')
      AND pf.updated_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
      AND p.current_phase NOT IN ('archived')
    LIMIT 30
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'critical_unresolved', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.created_at ASC) FROM (
    SELECT pf.id::text AS finding_id, pf.pathology_type AS type, pf.severity, pf.description,
      pf.affects_safety, pf.status, pf.created_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - pf.created_at))/86400)::int AS days_since_detected,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM pathology_findings pf
    JOIN projects p ON p.id = pf.project_id
    WHERE (pf.severity = 'critical' OR pf.affects_safety = true)
      AND pf.status NOT IN ('repaired', 'dismissed')
      AND p.current_phase NOT IN ('archived')
    LIMIT 20
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'total_issues', (
    (SELECT count(*) FROM pathology_findings pf JOIN projects p ON p.id = pf.project_id WHERE pf.status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed','monitored') AND pf.updated_at < now() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND p.current_phase NOT IN ('archived'))
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM pathology_findings pf JOIN projects p ON p.id = pf.project_id WHERE (pf.severity = 'critical' OR pf.affects_safety = true) AND pf.status NOT IN ('repaired','dismissed') AND p.current_phase NOT IN ('archived'))
  )::int
) AS report;
